params.heading: Need to Hit Your Pipeline Number, Fast?
params.subhead: A structured outbound program built around a ConnectAndSell seat — with Quantum running the support layer: lists, messaging, live coaching, reporting, and accountability. 8-12 live conversations per rep per hour.

params.prose:
SalesBlitz is not software you figure out alone. Your reps get the conversation-acceleration power of ConnectAndSell, and Quantum provides the people and process that make it convert:

ConnectAndSell seat included — live conversations instead of voicemails and phone trees
List building and enrichment for laser-focused targeting
Messaging and scripts built with your team
Live coaching during blitz sessions — 8-12 conversations per rep per hour
Reporting and accountability cadence so results compound week over week

Pick Your Blitz

Monthly Blitz

$1,000 Per Rep /month

Charged monthly · Minimum of 3 months

Up to 1,000 dials per month per rep
List building, enrichment and reporting
Set-up and onboarding
Messaging, scripts and live coaching
ConnectAndSell seat included
Get Started

Bi-Weekly Blitz

$1,200 Per Rep /month

Charged monthly · Minimum of 3 months

Up to 1,500 dials per month per rep
List building, enrichment and reporting
Set-up and onboarding
Messaging, scripts and live coaching
ConnectAndSell seat included
Get Started
Want to see how we run them first? Get the Sales Blitz Playbook →

Frequently Asked Questions

What is Sales Blitz as a Service?
A structured outbound program: your reps get a ConnectAndSell seat, and Quantum runs the support layer — list building, messaging, live coaching, reporting, and accountability.
How is it different from just buying ConnectAndSell?
ConnectAndSell gives you the dialing engine. The Blitz adds Quantum's people and process: scripts built with your team, coaching on live calls, and a weekly reporting and accountability cadence.
How many conversations will my reps actually have?
Blitz sessions typically produce 8-12 live conversations per rep per hour, coached in real time.
Do I need my own ConnectAndSell license?
No — a ConnectAndSell seat is included in the program.
What does it cost and what is the commitment?
Monthly Blitz runs $1,000 per rep per month and Bi-Weekly runs $1,200 per rep per month, each with a three-month minimum.
